modalities.evidence: 26 participants took part in this fMRI study
A single T1w structural scan was also acquired.

output.population: 26 participants: the choreographer, 14 dancers and 11 novices with no formal dance training; ages 19–43
output.summary: Functional MRI collected while participants passively watched a filmed dance performance in which movement synchrony varies among performers, plus a structural scan; participants included the choreographer, dancers, and novices.
